keys.description: A duplicate's name.

keys.name: move
keys.description: The drag handle's name.

keys.name: rowKeys
keys.default: "Enter opens its details, Delete removes it."
keys.description: Read with a row: what its keys do.

keys.name: actions
keys.default: { none: "Nothing", wait: "Wait", dock: "Dock", photo: "Take a photo", custom: "Custom action" }

keys.name: removed
keys.description: The toast after a delete, with Undo.

keys.name: position
keys.type: (x: number, y: number, locale: string | undefined) => string
keys.description: A waypoint's place, in the row.

keys.name: geoPosition
keys.type: (lat: number, lon: number, locale: string | undefined) => string

keys.name: actionShort
keys.default: (a, locale) => a.type === "wait" ? `Wait ${a.seconds.toLocaleString(locale)} s` : a.type === "dock" ? "Dock" : a.type === "photo" ? "Photo" : a.type === "custom" ? a.name || "Custom action" : ""
keys.description: The action in the row: "Wait 30 s", "Dock", the custom action's name.

keys.name: problem
keys.type: (p: WaypointProblem, minSpacing: number, locale: string | undefined) => string
keys.default: (p, min, locale) => p.kind === "noName" ? "Name missing" : p.kind === "noActionName" ? "Action name missing" : p.kind === "invalid" ? "Position is not a number" : p.kind === "outside" ? "Outside the map" : p.kind === "keepOut" ? `Inside ${p.zone ?? "a no-entry zone"}` : `${num(p.distance ?? 0, locale, 2)} m from the one before (at least ${num(min, locale)} m)`

keys.name: duration
keys.default: (s, locale) => { const t = Math.round(s) if (t < 60) return `about ${t.toLocaleString(locale)} s` const h = Math.floor(t / 3600) const m = Math.floor((t % 3600) / 60) return h ? `about ${h.toLocaleString(locale)} h ${m.toLocaleString(locale)} min` : `about ${m.toLocaleString(locale)} min ${(t % 60).toLocaleString(locale)} s` }

keys.name: unsaved
keys.description: The draft differs from the saved route.

keys.name: noChanges
keys.description: Why Save is disabled, beside it.

keys.name: blocked
keys.default: (n, locale) => (n === 1 ? "Fix 1 problem to save" : `Fix ${n.toLocaleString(locale)} problems to save`)

keys.name: saveFailed
keys.default: "The route could not be saved. Try again."

keys.name: savedNotice
keys.description: Said once the save went through.

keys.name: discarded
keys.description: The toast after Cancel threw changes away, with Undo.

keys.name: problems
keys.default: (n, locale) => (n === 0 ? "No problems left" : n === 1 ? "1 problem" : `${n.toLocaleString(locale)} problems`)
keys.description: Said (throttled) when the number of problems changes.

keys.name: readOnly
keys.default: "View only: you cannot change this route."
keys.description: A read-only editor says so above the list.

keys.name: details
keys.description: The selected waypoint under the map on a narrow editor: the button that opens it in the list.
